questions.question: How can section geometry help control wave drag at high Mach number?
choices: They make local flow incompressible.
They guarantee no shock at any speed.
They can reduce wave-drag penalties by managing compressibility effects.
They eliminate all aerodynamic drag.
questions.answerText: They can reduce wave-drag penalties by managing compressibility effects.
questions.explanation: Airfoil thickness and sweep influence local compression and wave formation. Shaping can reduce wave-drag penalties, although it cannot eliminate drag or shocks at every condition. Therefore, They can reduce wave-drag penalties by managing compressibility effects.
